title: 高強度混凝土高程泵送~High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete
focus: 把黏稠的高強度混凝土推上數百公尺：靜壓、管壁摩擦、輸送管強度、可泵性與連續供料~Pushing viscous high-strength concrete hundreds of metres up: static head, wall friction, pipeline strength, pumpability and continuous supply
summary: 超高層核心筒與巨柱的混凝土多以泵送輸送，600 m 的垂直高度本身就產生約 14 MPa 的靜壓，再加上高強度混凝土黏度高造成的管壁摩擦，泵機出口壓力可達 20 至 30 MPa 級。本課以哈里發塔 2008 年 606 m 的垂直泵送紀錄、上海中心大廈約 580 m 的泵送、平安金融中心以 C100 泵送至 555.5 m 等案例，說明壓力組成、潤滑層流變、高壓管與接頭、泵機功率、管線固定、開泵與清管、可泵性試驗、溫度與坍流度監測、磨耗檢測與強度追溯。~Concrete for supertall cores and megacolumns is mostly pumped; a vertical lift of 600 m alone creates about 14 MPa of static head, and wall friction from viscous high-strength mixes pushes pump outlet pressures into the 20 to 30 MPa range. Using Burj Khalifa's 2008 vertical pumping record of 606 m, pumping to about 580 m at Shanghai Tower and C100 concrete pumped to 555.5 m at Ping An Finance Center, the course covers pressure components, lubrication-layer rheology, high-pressure pipes and couplings, pump power, line fixing, start-up and flushing, pumpability testing, temperature and slump-flow monitoring, wear inspection and strength traceability.

units.anchor: 泵送壓力需求~Pump pressure demand
units.title: 高程泵送的壓力組成~Components of high-rise pumping pressure
units.mechanism: 泵機必須提供的壓力由三部分組成：把混凝土柱抬高的靜壓、混凝土沿管壁滑動的摩擦損失，以及彎管、錐形管與閥件的局部損失。對超高層而言，靜壓與高度成正比，600 m 時已經非常可觀；摩擦則與管長、流速、管徑與混凝土流變有關，高強度混凝土的低水膠比與高膠結料量使它更黏，摩擦明顯高於一般混凝土。三者相加決定泵機等級、輸送管壁厚與接頭型式，也決定是否需要在中途設接力泵。~The pressure a pump must deliver has three parts: static head to lift the concrete column, friction loss as concrete slides along the pipe wall, and local losses in bends, reducers and valves. In supertall work static head grows linearly with height and is already very large at 600 m; friction depends on line length, velocity, pipe diameter and rheology, and the low water–binder ratio and high binder content of high-strength concrete make it stickier, with markedly higher friction than ordinary concrete. Their sum sets the pump class, pipe wall thickness and coupling type, and decides whether an intermediate relay pump is needed.
units.model: p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local。ρ = 2,450 kg/m³、h = 600 m 時靜壓 = 2,450×9.81×600 ≈ 14.4 MPa；摩擦梯度 i = 0.010 MPa/m、管長 L = 700 m 得 7.0 MPa；10 個彎管各 0.1 MPa 得 1.0 MPa；合計約 22.4 MPa。數值為教學假設。~p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local. With ρ = 2,450 kg/m³ and h = 600 m the static head is 2,450×9.81×600 ≈ 14.4 MPa; a friction gradient i = 0.010 MPa/m over L = 700 m adds 7.0 MPa; ten bends at 0.1 MPa each add 1.0 MPa; the total is about 22.4 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以泵送計畫書列出最高澆置點的高度、總管長、彎管數與假設摩擦梯度，計算所需泵壓並保留裕度；施工中以泵機壓力紀錄與管線上的壓力感測器比對預測值，並隨樓層升高逐段更新。~List the highest placement level, total line length, number of bends and assumed friction gradient in the pumping plan, compute the required pressure with a margin, and during construction compare pump pressure logs and in-line pressure sensors with predictions, updating them as the building rises.
units.failure: 只以靜壓估算泵壓、低估高強度混凝土的摩擦，樓層升高後泵壓不足，混凝土在管中停滯並堵管；泵壓接近設備上限時，管線接頭與 S 閥磨耗加速，爆管風險升高。~Estimating pump pressure from static head alone and underrating friction of high-strength concrete leaves the pump short of pressure as the tower rises, so concrete stalls and blocks the line; running near the equipment limit accelerates wear of couplings and the S-valve and raises the risk of a pipe burst.
units.misconception: 泵送高度只要乘上混凝土密度就能算出所需泵壓。~Pump pressure can be found simply by multiplying height by concrete density.
units.practice: 泵送計畫要在每一個關鍵高程（例如每 100 m）重新計算泵壓與裕度，並明訂超過某壓力即需改配比、換管或設接力泵的決策點，由泵送工程師與混凝土供應商共同簽認。~Recalculate pressure and margin at each key level, for example every 100 m, and set decision points at which a mix change, new pipes or a relay pump is triggered above a given pressure, signed jointly by the pumping engineer and the concrete supplier.

units.title: 潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變~The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete
units.mechanism: 混凝土在管中並不是像水一樣整體流動，而是以塞流方式前進：中間的混凝土幾乎不剪切，只靠管壁附近一層薄薄的漿體或砂漿潤滑層滑動。ACI 304.2R 指出這層邊界潤滑層只有在泵送連續、配比穩定且供料不斷時才能維持。高強度混凝土的漿體黏度高，潤滑層的剪應力也較高，因此同樣流速下摩擦更大；配比中加入適量的細粉料、黏度調整劑或選擇合適的減水劑，可以在不降低強度的情況下改善可泵性。~Concrete does not flow through a pipe like water; it advances as a plug: the core barely shears and slides on a thin layer of paste or mortar at the wall. ACI 304.2R notes that this boundary lubrication layer survives only while pumping is continuous, the mix is consistent and supply is uninterrupted. High-strength concrete has a viscous paste, so the shear stress in the layer is higher and friction at a given velocity is greater; suitable fines, viscosity-modifying admixtures or a well-chosen superplasticiser can improve pumpability without reducing strength.
units.model: 管壁剪應力 τ = τ₀ + η_i·v，摩擦梯度 i = 2τ/R。管半徑 R = 0.0625 m、v = 1.0 m/s：一般高強配比 τ₀ = 30 Pa、η_i = 300 Pa·s/m，τ = 330 Pa，i ≈ 0.0106 MPa/m；黏度加倍 η_i = 600 時 τ = 630 Pa，i ≈ 0.0202 MPa/m，700 m 管線的總泵壓由約 22.8 MPa 升到約 29.5 MPa。數值為教學假設。~Wall shear stress τ = τ₀ + η_i·v and friction gradient i = 2τ/R. With R = 0.0625 m and v = 1.0 m/s, a typical high-strength mix with τ₀ = 30 Pa and η_i = 300 Pa·s/m gives τ = 330 Pa and i ≈ 0.0106 MPa/m; doubling η_i to 600 gives τ = 630 Pa and i ≈ 0.0202 MPa/m, raising total pressure on a 700 m line from about 22.8 MPa to about 29.5 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以管道流變儀或試驗迴路量測不同配比的界面屈服應力與黏度常數，或以兩支相距已知距離的壓力感測器量測實際摩擦梯度；把結果回填泵壓計算，選出在強度、坍流度與摩擦之間平衡的配比。~Measure interface yield stress and viscous constant for candidate mixes with a tribometer or test loop, or measure actual friction gradient with two pressure sensors a known distance apart; feed the results back into the pressure calculation and choose a mix that balances strength, slump flow and friction.
units.failure: 為了提高強度而一味降低用水量，混凝土黏度大增，潤滑層變薄，泵壓急升並出現間歇性堵管；配比中粗骨材級配不良時，漿體被擠出而骨材在彎管處形成架橋，造成難以清除的堵塞。~Cutting water to chase strength sharply raises viscosity, thins the lubrication layer and makes pump pressure spike with intermittent blockages; a poorly graded coarse aggregate lets paste be squeezed out so aggregate bridges at bends and forms blockages that are hard to clear.
units.misconception: 坍流度越大的混凝土就一定越容易泵送。~The higher the slump flow, the easier the concrete is to pump.
units.practice: 配比審查除強度與坍流度外，應要求提出可泵性證據（摩擦梯度或試驗迴路結果）與配比調整範圍；高層段若改用更高強度，必須重新做可泵性評估再放行。~Mix review should require pumpability evidence, such as friction gradient or loop results, and an allowed adjustment range in addition to strength and slump flow; any switch to higher strength in upper zones must be re-evaluated for pumpability before release.

units.anchor: 高壓輸送管與接頭~High-pressure pipes and couplings
units.title: 管壁厚度、接頭與磨耗裕度~Pipe wall thickness, couplings and wear allowance
units.mechanism: 超高層泵送管必須承受 20 MPa 以上的內壓，並在數萬立方公尺混凝土的磨耗下保持強度。常用的是經硬化處理的雙層或厚壁鋼管，以高壓法蘭或螺栓式接頭連接，接頭需同時防漏漿與承受拉脫力。管壁厚度由內壓與容許應力決定，再加上磨耗裕度；彎管外側磨耗最快，常做成加厚或可旋轉的耐磨彎頭。ACI 304.2R 提到早期活塞泵通常配用 150 mm 以上管徑，超高層則常用較小管徑以降低管內混凝土重量與接頭負擔。~Supertall pump lines must resist internal pressures above 20 MPa and keep their strength while tens of thousands of cubic metres of concrete wear them away. Hardened double-wall or thick-wall steel pipes are common, joined by high-pressure flanged or bolted couplings that must both seal against grout loss and resist pull-apart forces. Wall thickness is set by internal pressure and allowable stress plus a wear allowance; the outside of bends wears fastest and is often thickened or made as rotatable wear elbows. ACI 304.2R notes that early piston pumps typically used lines of 150 mm or more, whereas supertall lines often use smaller bores to reduce the weight of concrete in the line and the load on couplings.
units.model: Barlow 公式 t = pD/(2σ)。p = 22.4 MPa、D = 150 mm、容許應力 300 MPa 時 t = 22.4×150/600 = 5.6 mm；加上 4.4 mm 磨耗裕度，新管壁厚取 10 mm。若泵壓升到 29.5 MPa，所需厚度增為約 7.4 mm，磨耗裕度只剩 2.6 mm。數值為教學假設。~Barlow's formula t = pD/(2σ). With p = 22.4 MPa, D = 150 mm and 300 MPa allowable stress, t = 22.4×150/600 = 5.6 mm; adding a 4.4 mm wear allowance gives a 10 mm new wall. If pressure rises to 29.5 MPa, the required thickness grows to about 7.4 mm and only 2.6 mm of wear allowance remains. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 輸送管與接頭須有製造商的耐壓等級證明與材料硬度報告；安裝前逐根以超音波測厚記錄基準厚度並編號，接頭螺栓依規定扭力鎖緊並做標記，第一次加壓時巡查漏漿與滲水。~Pipes and couplings need the manufacturer's pressure rating and hardness reports; before installation record a baseline ultrasonic thickness for each numbered pipe, tighten coupling bolts to the specified torque and mark them, and walk the line for grout or water leaks at first pressurisation.
units.failure: 混用不同等級的管段或以一般接頭代替高壓接頭，在高壓段爆裂或拉脫，高速噴出的混凝土與管段碎片可傷及人員；彎管外側磨薄而未更換，在最高壓力時破裂。~Mixing pipe grades or substituting ordinary couplings for high-pressure ones lets the line burst or pull apart in the high-pressure zone, and concrete and fragments ejected at speed can injure people; bends worn thin on the outside and not replaced rupture at peak pressure.
units.misconception: 輸送管只是管子，任何鋼管只要接得上就能用於超高層泵送。~A pump line is just pipe, so any steel pipe that fits can be used for supertall pumping.
units.practice: 以管段編號與位置圖管理所有高壓管與彎頭，規定不同壓力區只能使用相對應等級的管件；接頭與管段的更換與測厚紀錄須能追溯，高壓區設人員禁入區與防護罩。~Manage every high-pressure pipe and elbow by number and location drawing, allow only matching pressure grades in each pressure zone, keep traceable replacement and thickness records, and set exclusion zones and guards around high-pressure sections.

units.anchor: 泵機與 S 閥~Pump unit and S-valve
units.title: 泵機輸出、壓力與功率~Pump output, pressure and power
units.mechanism: 超高壓拖式泵以兩支混凝土缸交替推送，S 閥在兩缸之間切換，把混凝土送入輸送管。泵機能提供的混凝土壓力取決於油壓與主油缸對混凝土缸的面積比，提高混凝土壓力就必須降低排量，因此同一台泵在高壓時輸出較小。哈里發塔的泵送站以兩台 Putzmeister BSA 14000 SHP-D 與一台 BSA 14000 HP-D 組成，泵機的機架、料斗與 S 閥都為預期壓力加強；上海中心大廈則以三一重工 HBT90CH 系列超高壓拖泵泵送核心筒混凝土。~An ultra-high-pressure trailer pump drives two concrete cylinders alternately, with an S-valve switching between them to feed the line. The concrete pressure a pump can deliver depends on hydraulic pressure and the area ratio between the drive cylinders and concrete cylinders, so higher concrete pressure means lower output, and the same pump delivers less at high pressure. Burj Khalifa's pumping station combined two Putzmeister BSA 14000 SHP-D units and one BSA 14000 HP-D, with frames, hoppers and S-valves reinforced for the expected pressures; Shanghai Tower used Sany HBT90CH-series ultra-high-pressure trailer pumps for its core concrete.
units.model: 水力功率 P = p·Q。排量 Q = 40 m³/h = 0.0111 m³/s、泵壓 22.4 MPa 時 P ≈ 249 kW，效率 0.75 時引擎約需 332 kW。管徑 125 mm 時截面 A ≈ 0.0123 m²，流速 v = Q/A ≈ 0.91 m/s，與前述 1.0 m/s 的摩擦假設一致。數值為教學假設。~Hydraulic power P = p·Q. At Q = 40 m³/h = 0.0111 m³/s and 22.4 MPa, P ≈ 249 kW, about 332 kW of engine power at 0.75 efficiency. In a 125 mm line the area is A ≈ 0.0123 m², so velocity v = Q/A ≈ 0.91 m/s, consistent with the 1.0 m/s friction assumption. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 核對泵機性能曲線，確認所需壓力與排量組合落在曲線內並有裕度；現場記錄每次泵送的出口壓力、行程頻率與排量，並安排備用泵機與關鍵零件（S 閥、眼鏡板、切割環），以免單機故障中斷澆置。~Check the pump's performance curve to confirm that the required pressure and output lie inside it with a margin; log outlet pressure, stroke rate and output for every pour, and keep a standby pump and critical spares such as S-valves, wear plates and cutting rings so that a single failure does not interrupt a pour.
units.failure: 泵機長時間在最高壓力下運轉，眼鏡板與切割環磨耗加快，漏漿使有效壓力下降，最終在關鍵澆置途中停機，形成冷縫；只依額定最大排量排程，忽略高壓時排量下降，供料計畫失準。~Running a pump at maximum pressure for long periods accelerates wear of the wear plate and cutting ring, leakage cuts effective pressure and the pump finally stops mid-pour, creating a cold joint; scheduling on the rated maximum output while ignoring the drop at high pressure throws the supply plan off.
units.misconception: 泵機的最大排量和最大壓力可以同時達到。~A pump can reach its maximum output and its maximum pressure at the same time.
units.practice: 重要澆置（例如巨柱或核心筒的關鍵段）前，泵機須完成保養並備妥備用機，泵送計畫書附上壓力—排量工作點；泵機操作員與樓上布料人員要有直接通訊，並規定停泵與降壓的指令方式。~Before critical pours such as key megacolumn or core lifts, service the pump and have a standby ready, attach the pressure–output operating point to the pumping plan, give the pump operator and the placing crew upstairs direct communication, and define how stop and pressure-relief orders are given.

units.anchor: 管線佈置與固定~Line layout and fixing
units.title: 管線佈置、固定與止回~Line layout, fixing and shut-off
units.mechanism: 垂直泵送管沿核心筒內的豎井或牆面設置，每層以管夾固定在結構上，承受管線與管內混凝土的重量以及每一次泵送衝程的脈動。彎管處的內壓會產生很大的推力，底部的水平轉垂直彎頭尤其關鍵，必須以混凝土座或鋼支架錨固。泵機出口與垂直段之間通常保留一段水平管，並在垂直段底部設置截止閥，停泵或更換管件時防止數百公尺混凝土柱回流衝擊泵機。管線也必須避開會隨樓層升高而移動的爬模平台。~The vertical line runs up a shaft or along walls of the core, clamped to the structure at every floor to carry the weight of pipe and concrete and the pulsation of each pump stroke. Internal pressure at bends produces large thrust, and the bottom horizontal-to-vertical elbow is especially critical, anchored in a concrete block or steel frame. A horizontal run is usually kept between the pump outlet and the vertical section, with a shut-off valve at the foot of the riser so that, when pumping stops or pipes are changed, hundreds of metres of concrete cannot flow back and hit the pump. The line must also clear climbing-form platforms that move up with the building.
units.model: 彎管推力 F = p·A。p = 22.4 MPa、A ≈ 0.0123 m² 時單向推力約 275 kN，90° 彎管合力約 √2×275 ≈ 389 kN。每 4 m 樓層的管線重：鋼管約 34.5 kg/m 加混凝土約 30.1 kg/m，共約 64.6 kg/m，每層管夾約承受 2.5 kN 的靜重，另加泵送脈動。數值為教學假設。~Bend thrust F = p·A. At p = 22.4 MPa and A ≈ 0.0123 m² the thrust is about 275 kN in each direction and the resultant at a 90° bend about √2×275 ≈ 389 kN. Per 4 m storey the line weighs about 34.5 kg/m of steel plus about 30.1 kg/m of concrete, about 64.6 kg/m, so each floor clamp carries about 2.5 kN of static weight plus pumping pulsation. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 管線佈置圖須標示每一個彎管位置、錨座設計反力、管夾間距與截止閥位置，由結構工程師確認錨座與預埋件能承受推力；首次高壓泵送時觀察底部錨座與管夾是否移位，並量測管線振動。~The line layout drawing should show every bend, anchor design reactions, clamp spacing and shut-off valve location, with the structural engineer confirming that anchors and embeds can take the thrust; at the first high-pressure pour watch the bottom anchor and clamps for movement and measure line vibration.
units.failure: 底部彎頭錨座不足，泵送脈動使彎頭逐漸移位，接頭被拉開而爆管；垂直段底部沒有截止閥，停泵時混凝土柱回流，S 閥與活塞受衝擊損壞，甚至造成人員傷害。~An inadequate anchor at the bottom elbow lets pumping pulses move it bit by bit until a coupling pulls apart and bursts; without a shut-off valve at the riser foot, the concrete column flows back when pumping stops, damaging the S-valve and pistons and possibly injuring people.
units.misconception: 垂直泵送管只要綁在牆上不會掉下來就可以，不需要計算推力。~A vertical pump line only needs tying to the wall so it does not fall; no thrust calculation is required.
units.practice: 管線錨座、管夾預埋件與通過樓板的開口應在結構施工圖中預先設計，而非現場臨時鑽孔；截止閥、洩壓與清管作業須有書面程序，並列為每次高壓泵送前的檢查項目。~Design line anchors, clamp embeds and slab openings into the structural shop drawings rather than drilling them ad hoc; give shut-off, pressure relief and line clearing written procedures and include them in the checklist before every high-pressure pour.

units.anchor: 開泵與水洗清管~Start-up and water flushing
units.title: 開泵潤管、連續供料與水洗清管~Priming, continuous supply and water flushing
units.mechanism: 每次泵送開始前，管線內壁必須先以砂漿或商用潤管劑完整潤滑，否則第一批混凝土會失去漿體而堵管。泵送中最重要的是連續供料：一旦中斷，潤滑層開始脫水，管內混凝土逐漸變硬，重新啟動時壓力急升。超高層管線很長、容積很大，澆置結束後要把管內數立方公尺的混凝土推出並清潔管線；三一重工在超高層專案中以水洗方式把管內混凝土直接推送至澆置點，減少浪費與高空拆管作業。~Before each pour the inside of the line must be fully lubricated with mortar or a commercial primer, or the first concrete loses its paste and blocks the line. During pumping the most important thing is continuous supply: once it stops the lubrication layer starts to dewater, concrete in the line stiffens, and pressure spikes on restart. Supertall lines are long and hold several cubic metres, so at the end of a pour that concrete must be pushed out and the line cleaned; on supertall projects Sany has used water flushing to push the concrete in the line through to the placement point, reducing waste and dismantling of pipes at height.
units.model: 管線容積 V = A·L = 0.0123×700 ≈ 8.6 m³，以 40 m³/h 充滿約需 12.9 min。潤管砂漿以 2 mm 厚覆蓋內壁：π×0.125×700×0.002 ≈ 0.55 m³。供料 40 m³/h 時，9 m³ 預拌車需每 13.5 min 到達一車，車次間隔一旦超過約 30 min 即需啟動低速循環或暫停程序。數值為教學假設。~Line volume V = A·L = 0.0123×700 ≈ 8.6 m³, about 12.9 min to fill at 40 m³/h. Priming mortar 2 mm thick on the wall needs π×0.125×700×0.002 ≈ 0.55 m³. At 40 m³/h a 9 m³ truck must arrive every 13.5 min; if the gap exceeds about 30 min, the slow-recirculation or stop procedure starts. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每次泵送記錄潤管材料與數量、首車到達時間、車次間隔、泵壓變化與清管方式；把車次間隔與泵壓尖峰對照，找出供料中斷造成的壓力異常，並與預拌廠檢討派車。~For each pour record priming material and quantity, first truck arrival, truck intervals, pressure changes and the cleaning method; compare truck gaps with pressure spikes to find supply-related anomalies and review dispatching with the ready-mix plant.
units.failure: 潤管砂漿不足或與混凝土配比不相容，第一車混凝土在泵機出口附近堵管；尖峰交通造成車次中斷 40 分鐘，重新啟動時壓力過高而爆管，或只能拆管清除已硬化的混凝土。~Too little or incompatible priming mortar lets the first truck block the line near the pump; a 40-minute gap in deliveries during rush hour means restarting at excessive pressure and bursting a pipe, or dismantling the line to clear hardened concrete.
units.misconception: 泵送中途停一下沒關係，混凝土還沒凝結，隨時可以再開泵。~Pausing mid-pour is harmless because the concrete has not set and pumping can resume at any time.
units.practice: 與預拌廠簽訂的供料計畫應包含最大車次間隔、備援車隊與交通尖峰對策；清管程序要規定水洗或球洗方式、管端出口的防護與廢水處理，並明訂只有指定人員可以打開管線。~The supply agreement with the ready-mix plant should include the maximum truck interval, a back-up fleet and rush-hour measures; the cleaning procedure should define water or ball flushing, protection at the discharge end and wash-water disposal, and allow only designated people to open the line.

units.anchor: 可泵性試驗與試泵~Pumpability tests and trial pumping
units.title: 可泵性試驗、試驗迴路與逐步加高~Pumpability tests, test loops and stepwise height increase
units.mechanism: 超高層泵送無法只靠配比表判斷可行性，必須在開工前做試驗並在施工中逐步驗證。常見作法是在地面鋪設長水平試驗迴路，量測不同配比在設計流速下的摩擦梯度，再換算到實際高程；也可在施工中隨樓層升高逐步提高泵送高度，累積實測數據。哈里發塔的預拌商 Unimix 在 2007 年先達到 452 m，2008 年再以 BSA 14000 SHP-D 創下 606 m 的垂直泵送紀錄，正是逐步驗證的例子。~Supertall pumping feasibility cannot be judged from a mix sheet; it needs tests before work starts and step-by-step verification during construction. A common approach lays a long horizontal test loop at ground level to measure the friction gradient of candidate mixes at design velocity and scale it to the real height; another is to raise pumping height step by step as floors rise, building up measured data. At Burj Khalifa the ready-mix supplier Unimix first reached 452 m in 2007, then set a vertical record of 606 m in 2008 with a BSA 14000 SHP-D, an example of stepwise verification.
units.model: 試驗迴路上兩個壓力感測器相距 100 m，量到壓差 1.06 MPa，摩擦梯度 i = 1.06/100 = 0.0106 MPa/m；換算到 700 m 實際管線摩擦約 7.4 MPa。但 300 m 長的水平迴路總壓只有約 3.2 MPa，遠低於實際 22 MPa 級，因此迴路試驗是用來校正摩擦參數，不能直接代表高壓下的設備行為。數值為教學假設。~Two pressure sensors 100 m apart on a test loop read a difference of 1.06 MPa, so i = 1.06/100 = 0.0106 MPa/m, scaling to about 7.4 MPa of friction on a 700 m line. But a 300 m horizontal loop reaches only about 3.2 MPa in total, far below the real 22 MPa class, so loop tests calibrate friction parameters and do not represent equipment behaviour at high pressure. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 試驗計畫列出配比、流速、溫度、感測器位置與允收準則（例如推算泵壓不超過泵機能力的 80%）；施工中每升高一個區段，比較實測泵壓與預測曲線，偏差持續擴大時暫停加高並檢討配比與管線。~The test plan lists mixes, velocities, temperatures, sensor positions and acceptance criteria, for example predicted pressure no more than 80% of pump capacity; as each height zone is reached, compare measured pressure with the predicted curve and pause the climb in height to review mix and line if the deviation keeps growing.
units.failure: 只在低樓層試泵合格就假設高樓層也能泵送，接近頂部時泵壓超過設備能力，高強度巨柱混凝土無法送達，只能改用吊斗或降低配比強度，延誤工期並引發設計變更。~Assuming that success on low floors means the top is pumpable lets pressure exceed equipment capacity near the top, so high-strength megacolumn concrete cannot be delivered and the job falls back on skips or a lower-strength mix, delaying the programme and forcing design changes.
units.misconception: 只要在地面試泵一次成功，整棟超高層都可以用同一配比泵送。~One successful trial at ground level means the same mix can be pumped to the top of a supertall.
units.practice: 把可泵性試驗、逐步加高的壓力紀錄與配比調整列為泵送計畫的必要章節，並在合約中規定混凝土供應商、泵送承包商與總承包商在堵管與配比調整上的責任分界。~Make pumpability tests, stepwise pressure records and mix adjustments mandatory chapters of the pumping plan, and set out in the contracts how responsibility for blockages and mix adjustments is divided among the concrete supplier, pumping subcontractor and main contractor.

units.anchor: 坍流度與溫度監測~Slump-flow and temperature monitoring
units.title: 泵送監測、坍流度保持與溫度上升~Pumping monitoring, slump-flow retention and temperature rise
units.mechanism: 超高層混凝土從拌合廠到樓頂需要經過運輸、等候、泵送與布料，總時間可能超過一小時，坍流度會隨時間損失；高溫地區還要面對混凝土溫度過高造成的坍流度快速損失與早凝。泵送本身也會加熱混凝土：克服摩擦的能量大部分轉成熱，使混凝土溫度上升。因此監測不能只在工地入口抽驗，還要在布料機出口取樣，比較泵送前後的坍流度、溫度與含氣量。~Supertall concrete travels from batch plant to roof through haulage, waiting, pumping and placing, possibly for more than an hour, and slump flow is lost with time; in hot regions high concrete temperature accelerates that loss and early stiffening. Pumping itself also heats the concrete: most of the energy spent overcoming friction becomes heat and raises its temperature. Monitoring therefore cannot rely only on sampling at the site gate; samples must also be taken at the boom outlet to compare slump flow, temperature and air content before and after pumping.
units.model: 坍流度損失每 30 min 約 30 mm，運輸 60 min 加管內 15 min 共 75 min，損失約 75 mm；出廠 700 mm 到出口約 625 mm，仍高於要求的 600 mm。摩擦造成的溫升 ΔT = Δp_friction/(ρc) = (7.4+1.0)×10⁶/(2,450×1,000) ≈ 3.4°C；靜壓部分轉為位能而非熱。數值為教學假設。~Slump flow drops about 30 mm per 30 min; 60 min of haulage plus 15 min in the line is 75 min and about 75 mm of loss, so 700 mm at the plant becomes about 625 mm at the outlet, still above the 600 mm requirement. Friction heating gives ΔT = Δp_friction/(ρc) = (7.4+1.0)×10⁶/(2,450×1,000) ≈ 3.4°C; the static-head part becomes potential energy, not heat. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在拌合廠、工地入口與布料機出口三處取樣，記錄坍流度、溫度、含氣量與時間戳記，並定期在出口製作強度試體；比較三處數據的變化趨勢，作為調整減水劑、緩凝劑或冷卻措施的依據。~Sample at the plant, the site gate and the boom outlet, recording slump flow, temperature, air content and time stamps, and periodically cast strength specimens at the outlet; use the trends across the three points to adjust superplasticiser, retarder or cooling measures.
units.failure: 只在工地入口驗收坍流度，忽略泵送後的損失與溫升，樓頂出口混凝土已變得太稠，工人在現場加水改善流動，強度與耐久性下降；高溫季節未調整澆置時段，泵壓與堵管頻率顯著升高。~Accepting slump flow only at the gate while ignoring loss and heating in the line leaves outlet concrete too stiff, and crews add water at the top to make it flow, reducing strength and durability; failing to shift pours to cooler hours in hot seasons markedly raises pump pressure and blockage frequency.
units.misconception: 混凝土在工地入口檢驗合格，泵送到樓頂後的性質也不會改變。~If concrete passes inspection at the site gate, its properties will not change after pumping to the top.
units.practice: 規範中明訂驗收取樣位置為布料機出口，並禁止在現場加水；高溫地區應規定混凝土最高溫度、冷卻措施（冰水、液氮或夜間澆置）與運輸時間上限，並由品管人員在樓頂執行抽驗。~Specify the boom outlet as the acceptance sampling point and prohibit adding water on site; in hot climates set a maximum concrete temperature, cooling measures such as chilled water, liquid nitrogen or night pours, and a haul-time limit, with quality staff sampling at the top.

units.anchor: 管壁超音波測厚~Ultrasonic pipe-wall thickness
units.title: 磨耗監測、爆管風險與更換時機~Wear monitoring, burst risk and replacement timing
units.mechanism: 高強度混凝土含大量硬質骨材，在高壓下高速通過管線，管壁與彎頭外側持續被磨薄；壁厚一旦降到內壓所需的最小值以下，就可能在最高壓力時爆裂。哈里發塔在 32 個月內泵送約 165,000 m³ 混凝土，這樣的累積量足以讓高磨耗位置的管件經歷數次更換。因此管線管理要以泵送量而不只以時間追蹤磨耗，並以測厚數據決定更換，而不是等到漏漿或破裂。~High-strength concrete carries plenty of hard aggregate through the line at high pressure, so pipe walls and the outside of elbows are continuously worn thinner; once the wall falls below the minimum needed for internal pressure, it can burst at peak pressure. Burj Khalifa pumped about 165,000 m³ of concrete over 32 months, enough for high-wear components to be replaced several times. Line management must therefore track wear against pumped volume, not just time, and replace parts on thickness data rather than waiting for leaks or ruptures.
units.model: 新管壁厚 10 mm、最小所需 5.6 mm，磨耗裕度 4.4 mm；若直管磨耗率 0.05 mm/1,000 m³，壽命約 4.4/0.05×1,000 = 88,000 m³；彎頭外側磨耗約為 3 倍，壽命約 29,000 m³。以 165,000 m³ 的總量計，直管至少更換一次，彎頭約需更換 5 次。數值為教學假設。~New walls are 10 mm with 5.6 mm required, a 4.4 mm wear allowance; at 0.05 mm per 1,000 m³ for straight pipe, life is about 4.4/0.05×1,000 = 88,000 m³, while the outside of an elbow wears about three times faster, giving about 29,000 m³. Over 165,000 m³, straight pipes need at least one replacement and elbows about five. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以超音波測厚儀在每根管與彎頭的固定測點定期量測，量測頻率依累積泵送量設定（例如每 5,000 m³ 一次），把讀值畫成厚度對泵送量的曲線預測更換時點；接近最小厚度的管件標示並排入更換。~Measure every pipe and elbow at fixed points with an ultrasonic gauge at intervals set by pumped volume, for example every 5,000 m³, plot thickness against volume to forecast replacement, and tag and schedule replacement for parts approaching the minimum thickness.
units.failure: 未建立測厚制度，以外觀判斷管件狀況，彎頭在高壓段突然破裂，混凝土與碎片噴出，泵送中斷並造成冷縫；更換管件時未分辨壓力等級，把低壓管裝到高壓段。~Without a thickness programme and judging pipes by appearance, an elbow in the high-pressure zone suddenly ruptures, spraying concrete and fragments, stopping the pour and leaving a cold joint; replacing parts without checking pressure grade puts low-pressure pipe into a high-pressure zone.
units.misconception: 管線外觀沒有漏漿或變形，就表示管壁厚度足夠。~If the line shows no leaks or deformation, the walls must still be thick enough.
units.practice: 管線維護計畫應包含測點位置圖、量測頻率、最小厚度、更換程序與備品數量；更換作業須先釋壓並確認截止閥關閉，由指定人員執行並記錄。~The line maintenance plan should include measuring-point drawings, frequency, minimum thickness, replacement procedure and spare quantities; replacements must follow pressure relief and confirmed shut-off, carried out and recorded by designated staff.

units.anchor: 泵送紀錄與強度追溯~Pumping records and strength traceability
units.title: 泵送紀錄、強度追溯與工程交接~Pumping records, strength traceability and handover
units.mechanism: 超高層的混凝土強度等級常隨高度分區變化，例如下部核心筒與巨柱使用最高等級，上部逐漸降低；平安金融中心在 2014 年封頂時以 C100 高強度混凝土泵送到 555.5 m。泵送管線中可能同時有前後兩種等級的混凝土，換料時的界面處理與澆置位置必須記錄清楚。交接時需要的不只是強度報告，而是每一次澆置的位置、等級、車次、泵壓、出口取樣結果與任何異常，讓日後鑽心或改修時可以追溯到當時的材料與條件。~Supertall concrete grades often change by height zone, the highest grade in lower cores and megacolumns and lower grades above; at Ping An Finance Center C100 high-strength concrete was pumped to 555.5 m at core top-out in 2014. A line may hold two grades in sequence, so the interface during a changeover and where it was placed must be recorded. Handover needs more than strength reports: it needs each pour's location, grade, truck numbers, pump pressure, outlet sampling results and any anomalies, so that future coring or alterations can be traced back to the materials and conditions at the time.
units.model: 以每 150 yd³（約 115 m³）至少一組強度試驗的頻率計，165,000 m³ 的泵送量至少需 165,000/114.7 ≈ 1,439 組試驗。若某一澆置區段的出口試體平均強度比入口低 3 MPa 以上，即標記為需調查的批次。數值為教學假設。~At no less than one strength test per 150 yd³ (about 115 m³), 165,000 m³ of pumped concrete needs at least 165,000/114.7 ≈ 1,439 tests. If outlet specimens in a pour zone average more than 3 MPa below gate specimens, that batch is flagged for investigation. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以澆置紀錄資料庫把每一車次對應到樓層與構件位置，將強度試驗結果、泵壓紀錄與出口取樣連結；交接前抽查資料庫完整性，確認每一個高強度區段都有對應的試驗與追溯資料。~Link each truck to floor and member location in a pour-record database, tied to strength results, pump-pressure logs and outlet samples; before handover audit the database for completeness and confirm that every high-strength zone has matching tests and traceability.
units.failure: 換料時未清楚分隔不同等級，低強度混凝土被誤澆到巨柱的高強度區段，事後只能大量鑽心檢驗甚至補強；紀錄只保存紙本且未對應位置，多年後改修時無法確認某處的實際強度等級。~Without clear separation at a grade change, lower-strength concrete is placed by mistake in a high-strength megacolumn zone, forcing extensive coring or even strengthening; records kept only on paper and not tied to locations leave later alterations unable to confirm the real grade at a given spot.
units.misconception: 只要強度試驗平均值合格，就不需要記錄每一車混凝土澆在哪裡。~If the average strength passes, there is no need to record where each truck was placed.
units.practice: 換料程序要規定界面混凝土的處理方式（例如先澆到較低等級的構件或棄置），並由現場工程師簽記；交接文件應包含可搜尋的澆置資料庫、強度統計、泵送紀錄與異常處理報告，作為維護與改修的依據。~The grade-change procedure should define how interface concrete is handled, for example placing it in a lower-grade member or discarding it, signed off by the site engineer; handover should include a searchable pour database, strength statistics, pumping logs and nonconformance reports as the basis for maintenance and alterations.

example: 計算練習：以 125 mm 管徑把高強度混凝土泵送到 600 m 高，總管長 700 m、10 個彎管、排量 40 m³/h。靜壓 2,450×9.81×600 ≈ 14.4 MPa；摩擦梯度由試驗迴路量得 0.0106 MPa/m，700 m 約 7.4 MPa；彎管 1.0 MPa；總泵壓約 22.8 MPa。管內流速 0.0111/0.0123 ≈ 0.91 m/s；水力功率 22.8×10⁶×0.0111 ≈ 253 kW，效率 0.75 時引擎約 338 kW。以 D = 150 mm、容許應力 300 MPa 計，所需壁厚 22.8×150/600 ≈ 5.7 mm，取 10 mm 新管保留磨耗裕度。若為提高強度使界面黏度加倍，摩擦梯度升到 0.0202 MPa/m，總泵壓約 29.5 MPa，功率約 328 kW、引擎約 437 kW，所需壁厚增為約 7.4 mm，磨耗裕度與管件壽命都大幅縮短，可能需要改用接力泵或調整配比。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案。~Calculation exercise: high-strength concrete is pumped through a 125 mm line to 600 m, with 700 m of line, ten bends and 40 m³/h output. Static head is 2,450×9.81×600 ≈ 14.4 MPa; the loop-measured friction gradient of 0.0106 MPa/m gives about 7.4 MPa over 700 m; bends add 1.0 MPa; total pressure is about 22.8 MPa. Line velocity is 0.0111/0.0123 ≈ 0.91 m/s; hydraulic power is 22.8×10⁶×0.0111 ≈ 253 kW, about 338 kW of engine at 0.75 efficiency. With D = 150 mm and 300 MPa allowable stress, the required wall is 22.8×150/600 ≈ 5.7 mm, so 10 mm new pipe keeps a wear allowance. If interface viscosity doubles to gain strength, friction rises to 0.0202 MPa/m and total pressure to about 29.5 MPa, power to about 328 kW and engine to about 437 kW, and the required wall to about 7.4 mm, sharply shortening wear allowance and pipe life, so a relay pump or a mix adjustment may be needed. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.
history: ACI 304.2R 記載機械式活塞泵於 1933 年在美國密爾瓦基出現，早期多用 150 mm 以上的管徑。超高層建築把泵送高度推向數百公尺：哈里發塔的預拌商 Unimix 在 2007 年達到 452 m，2008 年以 Putzmeister BSA 14000 SHP-D 創下 606 m 的垂直泵送紀錄；三一重工公布上海中心大廈於 2013 年封頂核心筒時泵送至約 580 m，平安金融中心 2014 年以 C100 泵送至 555.5 m，2015 年天津高銀金融 117 以 621 m 創下金氏世界紀錄。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~ACI 304.2R records that mechanical piston pumps appeared in Milwaukee in 1933, usually with lines of 150 mm or more. Supertall buildings pushed pumping heights to hundreds of metres: at Burj Khalifa the ready-mix supplier Unimix reached 452 m in 2007 and set a vertical record of 606 m in 2008 with a Putzmeister BSA 14000 SHP-D; Sany reports pumping to about 580 m at Shanghai Tower's core top-out in 2013, C100 concrete to 555.5 m at Ping An Finance Center in 2014, and a Guinness record of 621 m at Goldin Finance 117 in Tianjin in 2015. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 2008 年哈里發塔以 Putzmeister BSA 14000 SHP-D 創下 606 m 垂直泵送紀錄，2007 年先達 452 m~In 2008 Burj Khalifa set a 606 m vertical pumping record with a Putzmeister BSA 14000 SHP-D, after reaching 452 m in 2007
哈里發塔在 32 個月內泵送約 165,000 m³ 混凝土~About 165,000 m³ of concrete was pumped at Burj Khalifa over 32 months
上海中心大廈 2013 年 8 月 3 日核心筒封頂時泵送高度約 580 m~Shanghai Tower's core top-out on 3 August 2013 involved pumping to about 580 m
平安金融中心 2014 年 12 月 29 日以 C100 混凝土垂直泵送至 555.5 m~Ping An Finance Center pumped C100 concrete vertically to 555.5 m on 29 December 2014
天津高銀金融 117 於 2015 年 9 月 8 日以 621 m 創下垂直泵送金氏世界紀錄~Goldin Finance 117 in Tianjin set a Guinness vertical pumping record of 621 m on 8 September 2015
ACI 304.2R 指出現代泵機最大理論排量超過約 190 m³/h~ACI 304.2R notes that modern pumps exceed about 190 m³/h of theoretical maximum output
